title: pr-631112-onboard-aegis-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Onboard Aegis-13b v1.0 into the model registry with performance profiles, updated metadata, and changelog/release-notes automation. Motivation: Aegis-13b is a community model that matches our throughput/quality targets for mid-tier conversational workloads; customers requested a 13B variant with verified perf data for Dedicated and Private deployments. This PR includes: - model metadata (artifact hashes, tokenizer, config) - perf profiles for common sequence length buckets and hardware (A100-40GB, A100-80GB, H100-80GB) - quantization compatibility flags and suggested quantization profiles - automated changelog entry generator that pulls perf profile diffs and metadata into the RELEASE_NOTES.md template - a lightweight onboarding test harness that validates sample prompts and perf measurements in CI Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata and S3 artifact pointers - [x] Generate perf profiles (latency/throughput/cost estimates) - [x] Wire changelog automation (GH action) - [x] Add unit tests for metadata parser - [x] Docs: reference page and quickstart snippet Testing notes: - Perf data generated using benchmark-lab against staging clusters (seq_len 128/256/512) - CI runs include model-registry unit tests and a synthetic perf smoke test; full perf runs are recorded in artifacts. Rollout plan: merge to main, tag model v1.0 in registry, wait 24h for canary traffic to Dedicated, then promote to hosted catalog. See linked Linear tickets for rollout gating criteria.
commits: 5 commits: initial metadata and manifest; add perf profiles for A100/H100; add quantization flags and q8 suggestions; changelog GH action; test harness and unit tests

discussion_summary: Reviewers requested kv-cache validation and model-hash in filenames; author added small fixes. Changelog automation uses a GH action that renders RELEASE_NOTES.md from perf profile diffs and metadata changes; action includes a dry-run mode for PR previews.
release_notes:
- Added Aegis-13b v1.0 to model registry with validated perf profiles for A100/H100 and recommended quantization settings.
- Introduced changelog-generator GH action: automatically creates release note entries from perf profile diffs and metadata changes.
- Small test harness and metadata parser unit tests added to validate onboarding steps.
notes_for_ops: Ops: after merge tag models/aegis/13b/v1 as v1.0; monitor latency and error-rate dashboards for 48h. Changelog action will publish draft release notes to the releases bucket; manually review before public release.
how_to_verify: 1) Checkout main and run tools/changelog-generator in dry-run mode against the new perf profiles. 2) Confirm model manifests are present in models/aegis/13b/v1/metadata.yaml. 3) Run tests: pytest tests/model_registry -k aegis. 4) Verify artifacts uploaded to CI (perf artifacts and kv-cache validation logs).
